name: PayPal account limitation (document request or 180-day hold)

intake.label: What date was the account limited?
intake.why: The 180-day clock and the cover message both start here.

intake.label: What does PayPal say it needs?
intake.why: A document request is a checklist. A permanent limitation is a different letter with a different goal: releasing the funds.

intake.label: List each item PayPal asks for in the Resolution Center.
intake.why: This case is won on document completeness. The pack is built from PayPal's own list.

intake.label: Describe your business: what you sell, to whom, how it is delivered and the typical order value.
intake.why: The risk team's first question is what the money is for. A clear answer resolves a large share of these.

intake.label: How long between payment and delivery?
intake.why: Long delivery windows and preorders are the main trigger for a hold. Explaining yours is the core of the letter.

intake.label: Can you show proof of stock and supplier relationships?
intake.why: Proof of fulfilment capacity is what shortens a hold.

intake.label: What is your refund policy and where is it published?
intake.why: The risk team reads it. Having it written and linked is a fact, not a promise.

intake.label: How many chargebacks or disputes have you had in the last 6 months, and how were they handled?
intake.why: Honest numbers with handling detail beat an assurance that there are none.

intake.label: Has your volume or average order value changed suddenly?
intake.why: A spike is often the whole reason for the review.

evidence.label: The limitation notice or Resolution Center screenshot
evidence.why: We build the checklist from PayPal's own wording.

evidence.label: Photo ID and proof of address
Supplier invoices or proof of stock
evidence.why: Evidences that you can fulfil the orders behind the held funds.

evidence.label: Tracking numbers or delivery confirmations for recent orders
evidence.why: The single most effective document for shortening a hold.

evidence.label: Your published refund, shipping and terms pages
evidence.why: Shows the risk team the customer-facing commitments.

evidence.label: Business bank statement
evidence.why: Sometimes requested to confirm the trading entity.

sections.heading: Document pack index
sections.guidance: Numbered list matching PayPal's request item for item, each with the filename and what it evidences.

sections.heading: Cover message
sections.guidance: Short. The business, what is sold, to whom, how it ships, typical order value, and the date range of the orders behind the held balance.

sections.heading: Fulfilment and refunds
sections.guidance: Delivery times with tracking evidence, the published refund policy, and dispute handling with real numbers.

sections.heading: Requested outcome
sections.guidance: One or two sentences: lift the limitation, or where the limitation is permanent, release the balance on the stated date and confirm the withdrawal method.

output.opening: One sentence naming the account email, the limitation date and what is being asked for.
output.closing: One line listing the attachments by filename.

rejection_patterns.check: Every item PayPal asked for appears in the document pack index and the confirmed evidence.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: An item PayPal asked for is not in the pack. The review will not progress until it is.

rejection_patterns.check: Tracking or delivery confirmation is in the confirmed evidence.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: Without delivery evidence the risk team has no reason to shorten the hold.

rejection_patterns.check: No paragraph scores above 0.6 for genericity.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: This paragraph could belong to any business. The risk team is reading for specifics about yours.

rejection_patterns.check: The message does not argue that PayPal has no right to hold the funds.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: Arguing entitlement does not move a risk review. Evidence of fulfilment does.

rejection_patterns.check: None of: unfortunately, I assure you, please give me one more chance, loyal seller, unfair.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: This phrase appears in rejected appeals more than in accepted ones. Remove it.

rejection_patterns.check: No [MISSING: ...] markers remain in the draft.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: A required fact is missing. Answer the question or upload the document.

rejection_patterns.check: Dispute numbers are stated with how they were handled.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: Vague dispute answers invite a longer review. Give the numbers.

rejection_patterns.check: The refund policy is stated and published somewhere the reviewer can see it.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: An unpublished refund policy reads as no refund policy.

steps: Log in and open the Resolution Center.
Open the limitation task and upload each requested document against its own item.
Paste the cover message where a note is allowed, or send it through Message Center referencing the case.
Where the limitation is permanent, confirm the withdrawal method now so the balance releases without a further exchange on day 180.
submission.turnaround: PayPal usually reviews documents within 3 business days. A permanent limitation holds the balance for 180 days from the limitation date.
